title: Google\Cloud\Spanner\Result
name: Result
description: Represent a Cloud Spanner lookup result (either read or executeSql).

params.name: session
params.description: The session used for any operations executed.

params.name: call
params.description: A callable, yielding a generator filled with results.

params.name: retries
params.description: Number of attempts to resume a broken stream, assuming a resume token is present. Defaults to 3.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Return the formatted and decoded rows. If the stream is interrupted and a resume token is available, attempts will be made on your behalf to resume.

params.name: format
params.description: Determines the format in which rows are returned. Result::RETURN_NAME_VALUE_PAIR returns items as a multi-dimensional array containing a name and a value key. Ex: [0 => ['name' => 'column1', 'value' => 'my_value']]. Result::RETURN_ASSOCIATIVE returns items as an associative array with the column name as the key. Please note with this option, if duplicate column names are present a \RuntimeException will be thrown. Result::RETURN_ZERO_INDEXED returns items as a 0 indexed array, with the key representing the column number as found by executing %1$s. Ex: [0 => 'my_value']. Defaults to Result::RETURN_ASSOCIATIVE.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Return the session associated with the result stream.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Get the query plan and execution statistics for the query that produced this result set.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot which was begun in the read or execute, if one exists.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Returns a transaction which was begun in the read or execute, if one exists.
